objective: Falsify unsound implementation-closure producers before admitting any positive implementation-preservation authority.
epistemic_rule: A producer does not gain closure authority by declaration, repetition, coverage, or a finite clean trace. In this gate, a closure claim survives only when an independent synthetic oracle confirms exact implementation binding, exact world-domain binding, complete declared operational-boundary enumeration, consequence-sequence completeness, and exact realized-relation equality with no unresolved execution or parse state.
oracle_non_authority: The C0 oracle exists only to kill unsound producer strategies in this synthetic falsification laboratory. It is not a production K1 proof kind and cannot be cited as implementation closure outside C0.
candidate_obligations_under_attack: exact executable identity rather than source label or producer-selected identity
exact equality with the W0 admitted-world domain rather than a producer-selected subset
explicit closure over consequence-relevant environment dimensions
explicit closure over persistent state/history dimensions
explicit closure over randomness or nondeterministic choice
explicit closure over time classes when time can affect consequences
explicit closure over schedule/interleaving classes when scheduling can affect consequences
sequence-complete consequential observation rather than first-effect-only projection
open consequence universe: target-native or previously unknown consequences may not be dropped
timeout, unresolved execution, malformed observation, or incomplete parsing cannot be laundered into an empty safe result
coverage metrics and repeated clean executions are diagnostic evidence only, never closure authority
producer self-attestation of closed=true is non-authoritative
precommitted_attack_vectors: C0-P1 exact exhaustive bounded closure positive control
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add MUST/liveness merely to rescue a failed closure producer
do not treat sample count as exhaustiveness
do not equate branch coverage with consequence-space closure
do not close the consequence universe to source-known labels
do not trust producer-supplied closed, grounded, complete, or covered booleans
do not weaken a failing vector after observing its outcome
decision_after_gate: If all unsound strategies are killed and positive controls survive, derive the minimum closure-proof obligations and design C1 as an independently checkable bounded implementation-adequacy proof lane. If any unsound strategy survives, C1 is forbidden until the hole is repaired.
